title: ScriptManifest
description: Deterministic ingestion output of an externally-authored, EDITORIALLY LOCKED Thai master script (master_script.md, produced upstream by an OpenAI writer -- research, sourcing, thesis, story selection, pacing, structure, and final Thai prose are all decided before this repository ever sees the script). Produced once by scripts/ingest_script.py, with NO LLM involved, and never rewritten -- narration_text in each block is verbatim from the upstream script except for trailing citation-link markup, which is moved to source_refs so TTS never reads a URL aloud. This file is now the sole editorial source of truth for what gets spoken. Claude's production work (B-DISCOVER/B-EDIT) begins after this file exists and must not alter its narration_text, reorder its blocks, or add/remove facts -- Claude decides only what is shown, never what is said.

topic.description: The vehicle/topic name originally supplied to the upstream writer. Record-keeping only -- never used to drive any editorial decision in this repository.

script_sha256.description: SHA-256 of master_script.md's raw bytes at ingestion time, so any downstream artifact (TTS audio, asset_inventory, edit_plan) can be proven to trace back to this exact locked script.

title.description: From the master script's first Markdown H1.

optional_deck.description: A single italic line immediately under the H1, if present and unambiguous -- metadata, not a spoken block.

language.description: Snapshot of the channel's output_language at ingestion time, e.g. 'th'.

status.description: Always locked. A master script is only ever ingested once fully authored upstream -- there is no draft/in-progress state for this file in this repository.

source_script_path.description: Path (relative to the episode directory) to the verbatim copy of master_script.md preserved alongside this file.

blocks.description: Deterministic paragraph-level blocks, in the master script's own order. Block formation is mechanical (blank-line-separated paragraphs) -- this file does not invent story beats, acts, or structure the upstream script didn't already have.

narration_text.description: Verbatim spoken prose for this block, with only trailing citation-link markup removed. Never rewritten, summarized, translated, corrected, or improved by Claude -- if it reads awkwardly, that is an upstream editorial matter, out of scope here.

source_refs.description: Citation-style links found at the end of this block's paragraph, extracted so TTS never reads a URL aloud. Hints/provenance for Claude's visual research only -- never a fact-check gate; Claude does not re-verify the upstream writer's claims before producing visuals.
